### MSS-Login Universal Model Downloader Workflow

Download models from CivitAI or Hugging Face into your ComfyUI server remotely (via web or Comfy Portal app).

**Prerequisites & Privileges:**
- **Download Permission:** Requires the `can_download_models` role permission.
- **API Tokens:**
  - *Profile Token (Recommended):* Save your CivitAI or Hugging Face token in your MSS-Login profile under **Settings ⚙️ → MSS-Login → Model Download → API Keys** (stored encrypted at rest in the database).
  - *Node Token:* You can also enter your token directly into the `api_key` field on this node. It will be used for the download and automatically saved to your profile if you don't already have one configured.
  - *Server Fallback:* If `CIVITAI_TOKEN` or `HF_TOKEN` is configured on the server, it is used automatically when no user key is set.

**Universal Features:**
- **Smart URL Detection:** Simply paste any CivitAI model page URL or Hugging Face file URL into `url`. The downloader automatically parses the provider, model IDs, filename, and recommended target folder.
- **Direct Identifiers:**
  - CivitAI: set `source` to `civitai` and specify `model_version_id`.
  - Hugging Face: set `source` to `huggingface` and specify `repo_id` and `filename`.
- **Target Folder:** Route into `checkpoints`, `loras`, `vae`, `unet`, `diffusion_models`, `text_encoders`, `clip_vision`, `controlnet`, or `upscale_models`.
- **Model Isolation Toggle:**
  - `true` (Private): Store in your personal private directory (`DATA_DIR/model_isolation/...`) with automatic private ACL grant.
  - `false` (Shared): Store in the global shared library (`models/...`). Requires admin or model sharing permissions.

Queue this workflow to download in background with live WebSocket progress!
